en: Welcome back, everyone.{PAGE}It was quite a spectacle to watch you{SAUT}overcome that new security system.

Hmm, that's Yukiko-chan for you―{SAUT}creative beyond comprehension.

Since when was "Junpei's Believe It, or{SAUT}Don't" funny!?{PAGE}...Well, whatever.{PAGE}Yukki and I will just have to keep the{SAUT}stories comin' and keep everyone{SAUT}engaged! You can count on us!
